title: Chapter 3 A Strong Man Above The Evil God Abyss
content:
Chapter 3 A Strong Man Above The Evil God Abyss

Seeing Lu Daosheng's intense reaction, Lu Xue immediately lowered her head, feeling extremely aggrieved.

"Dad, I just want to try. I can't stay in the deserted city forever, and it's not like I won't come back."

At the end, Lu Xue's voice was getting smaller and smaller.

However, Lu Daosheng still shook his head.

"I said, no."

"Woo woo,"

Suddenly, crying came from Lu Xue's mouth.

Hearing his daughter crying, Lu Daosheng softened his heart.

Touching Lu Xue's little head, Lu Daosheng said helplessly: "Xiaoxue, the hearts of people in this cultivation world are unpredictable. Stay with Dad in the future, Dad will protect you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue wiped her tears and said: "But Dad, I also want to become a strong man and want to protect Dad in the future."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng sighed.

It seems that his daughter is determined to find a master to practice well.

After all, this place is remote and has little spiritual energy. Whether you can become a strong man depends on whether you can have a powerful master, so that you can have resources.

Lu Daosheng thought about teaching in person, but Lu Daosheng gave up.

The gap between him and Lu Xue is too big now. I guess she can't understand what he said.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng said slowly: "Xiaoxue, since you want to find a master, then Dad will find one for you."

Isn't it just a master? With your current ability, can't you find a good master? Even if Dad is tied to you, he will tie one back for you.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Lu Xue hesitated.

"Dad, is the one you find reliable?"

Seeing Lu Xue's doubt about him, Lu Daosheng smiled casually.

"Just wait and see."

Seeing this, Lu Xue sighed and said nothing more.

Anyway, when the time comes, just wait until the person Dad finds is compared with the one I find.

Dad should have nothing to say by then.

Then, Lu Xue left.

At the original place, Lu Daosheng did not hesitate and directly released his spiritual sense. Suddenly, Lu Daosheng's spiritual sense directly enveloped the entire Tianxuan world.

All the forbidden places and unknown places that made the creatures in the world tremble were exposed to Lu Daosheng without any obstruction.

Feeling the creatures in the Tianxuan world, Lu Daosheng shook his head and sighed.

These existences that were once unattainable in his eyes are now like ants.

Soon, Lu Daosheng locked on a place called the Evil God Abyss.

It is rumored that the legendary evil god is suppressed here, and it is also the most terrifying forbidden place.

No creature can come out alive.

Because once you step in, the terrifying devouring power in the abyss will submerge everything.

Even saints are no exception.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng appeared above the Evil God Abyss.

At the same time, the endless devouring power also spread towards Lu Daosheng, but it could not touch Lu Daosheng at all.

After taking a look around, Lu Daosheng looked into the void in the distance.

I saw a middle-aged man with long hair sitting cross-legged in the void, and the domineering look between his eyebrows was even more intimidating.

And this man was Lu Daosheng's purpose this time.

After all, he couldn't possibly come to find that evil god to be his daughter's master.

At this time, the middle-aged man in the distance slowly opened his eyes and looked at Lu Daosheng.

His eyes were filled with endless vicissitudes, and I don't know how long he has been here.

"Who are you?"

After taking a look at Lu Daosheng, the middle-aged man frowned slightly and asked in confusion.

He couldn't see through the person in front of him at all.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and said, "I am the lord of Huangcheng, Lu Daosheng. I came here this time to ask fellow Taoists to do me a favor."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man was silent for a moment, and slowly said, "My name is Gu Chen, and everyone in the world calls me Fan Di."

Fan Di!

Lu Daosheng was surprised that the person in front of him was actually the legendary Fan Di.

Having been in this Xuantian world for more than ten years, Lu Daosheng naturally heard the legend of Fan Di, who was a figure from a million years ago.

"Everyone thought you were dead."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, Fan Di was silent.

A million years ago, the darkness was turbulent, and Fan Di suppressed it alone, and repelled the darkness at the cost of his life.

This is the legend of Fan Di in the world.

Obviously, legends are just legends, not very real.

After a long time, Gu Chen slowly said: "Go, no matter what you need, I can't help."

With Gu Chen's eyesight, he could naturally see that Lu Daosheng was not an ordinary person, and Lu Daosheng had no ill intentions.

So Gu Chen was still polite to Lu Daosheng.

In the distance, Lu Daosheng did not leave.

He looked at the abyss below and said: "You already have the strength to leave the Tianxuan world, why do you still stay here."

In the abyss below, there are endless evil demons, a kind of creature that likes to destroy and kill everywhere. Gu Chen is here to suppress these evil demons.

Once Gu Chen leaves, the Tianxuan world will be in danger.

"In the outside world, it seems that no one knows your efforts."

At this time, Lu Daosheng continued to speak.

"Alas."

A heavy sigh sounded.

Gu Chen looked up at the starry sky with yearning in his eyes.

"Back then, I also thought about leaving, but if I don't stand up, who else can stand up? The greater the ability, the greater the responsibility. I can't just watch the Tianxuan world destroyed."

Papapapa!

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but start to applaud.

He is worthy of being called the most promising emperor. If there hadn't been the dark turmoil back then, Gu Chen would definitely be much more than this now.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng admired Gu Chen more and more.

This is what his daughter's teacher should look like.

It's you!

"How about we make a deal?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng said.

Hearing this, Gu Chen looked over.

Lu Daosheng continued: "I will help you solve these evil demons, and you can go with me, how about it?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen was stunned.

Solve these evil demons.

If these evil demons could be solved, he would have solved them long ago.

But these evil demons cannot be killed. Once killed, they will be resurrected soon. In the end, he had no choice but to suppress these evil demons in the abyss himself.

And it was not only the evil demons that were suppressed, but also himself.

After a moment of silence, Gu Chen said lightly: "If you can really get rid of these evil demons, I will go with you."

"Okay, it's a deal."

Seeing Gu Chen agreed, Lu Daosheng immediately agreed.

At this time, a shrill evil laugh came from the abyss below.

"Hehehe, where did this kid come from to be so shameless."

"You are just dreaming to get rid of us."

"Emperor Fan, if I hadn't been injured that year and you had picked up the opportunity, how could I be suppressed by you."

Hearing this, Gu Chen ignored it and just looked at Lu Daosheng lightly.

As if to say, come on, show it.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng came to life.

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand.

Suddenly, a terrifying attraction surged out.

"Ah! What, what is this?!"

Buzz——

A dark, ugly and extremely gloomy monster was attracted to Lu Daosheng's palm.

The world in the palm!

"Die!"

As Lu Daosheng's voice fell.

A shrill scream suddenly sounded from the mouth of the evil demon.

"Ah! You, you can't kill me, you, ah!, no, it's impossible! What kind of power is this!"

"Senior, spare me, senior, spare me!"

As the sound gradually decreased, there was no sound.

The evil demon suddenly dissipated completely between heaven and earth, leaving only a pure energy in Lu Daosheng's palm.
